correctness.rationale: The tame (Z/3)^3 cover of P1 with four order-3 inertia branches has 2g-2=27(-2)+4*9*2=18 and g=10. Character-eigen differential local valuations show precisely ten one-dimensional holomorphic eigenspaces. As p=7≡1 mod3, Cartier preserves them; the seventh powers of Cartier scalars arise from the coefficient x^(6+7 deg h) in h f_a^(2j). Independent polynomial coefficient calculation modulo 7 reproduced all ten entries: four nowhere vanishing on λ∉{0,1}, and each quadratic A=λ²−λ−1, B=λ²+λ−1, D=λ²−3λ+1 appearing twice. A,B,D are separable, pairwise coprime, irreducible over F7, yielding Cartier rank/p-rank 10 off six F49 points, 8 on them, and a-number 0 or 2. Determinant equals λ^6(λ−1)^6 A²B²D². Independent exact polynomial arithmetic verified 256(λ²−λ+1)^3−4λ²(λ−1)²=4ABD mod 7; thus precisely one j_br=4 geometric unordered moduli point, with unramified anharmonic covering and order-two divisor. p-rank8 in genus10 leaves four nonordinary slopes; symmetry/integrality forces four 1/2 slopes. Full char7 algebraic statements use exact symbolic identities, not finite F7 sampling.
